answers.reason: The full professor is a member of the university and takes part in their designated body, but the description does not explicitly place them in the senate.
Budget planning is handled by the leadership and central administration, not by a full professor.
As a professor holding a chair in the faculty, they are part of the academic body selecting candidates for professorships.
As a member of the faculty, the full professor takes part in the faculty council.
The full professor is part of the faculty's teaching and academic matters handled in the study commission.
Examination boards deal with individual student matters and are not general faculty member bodies.
As a researcher leading a research group, the full professor participates in internal research funding.
Module revisions are part of the academic study programmes handled by faculty members like the full professor.
Laboratory equipment procurement is tied to the professor's research and teaching leadership.
Orientation week planning is typically for students and student representatives rather than full professors.
